document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
A streak of misty vapor stabs past you and you feel the sting 
of  frostbite.  The  fungoid  monsters!  On  three  sides  of  you! 
You are penned against the river. Your only hope is to try to 
swim it, even though the water flows rapidly and swirls with 
treacherous eddies.
Make a Dodge roll: if you succeed, go to 512; if you fail, go to 332.
